verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a dot is one persistent agent: its memory carries across ChatGPT, Slack, Teams and calls, and it keeps notes on preferences, decisions and ongoing work. It can also reach connected files and drives. That gives shared context, but nothing shows a way to group related chats and files into separate projects or spaces with their own instructions. Missing for 10: a project or space container for grouping chats and files, per-project instructions, per-project context scoping, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
